<thought>To identify elements definitively, I examined the mass spectrum. The most prominent peaks are at m/z 233.96 (100 % intensity) and a nearby peak 2 Da lower at m/z 231.97 with ~77 % intensity, plus a smaller peak 2 Da higher at m/z 235.96 (~24 %). The ~2 Da spacing and the characteristic intensity ratios are indicative of chlorine, whose isotopic pattern (³⁵Cl/³⁷Cl) shows a 3:1 (≈75 % vs 100 %) intensity for the M and M+2 peaks. This matches the observed ~77 % intensity for the –2 Da peak relative to the main peak. No other element in the provided list (Br, S, etc.) exhibits a comparable pattern in this region. Therefore, chlorine can be definitively identified from the spectrum.> 
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
